title: Running the tabulation preamble
statement: Let $z$ and $x$ be lists of Boolean values, and let $W$ be a nonnegative integer. Running the tabulation preamble formed from the constant gates for false and true, the constant gates for the entries of $z$, and $W$ further false constant gates, from initial list $x$, yields $x$ followed by $[false,true]$, then $z$, then $W$ copies of $false$.
